messages:
katie: FYI customer reports rerank endpoint returning 404s and sometimes all-zero scores. their client is calling model_id=rerank-legacy-v1.

sam: ugh, legacy id — that one was deprecated last month. do we still have a redirect/alias in place for tenants?

jun: checking routing table now. can you paste their tenant id and example request?

katie: tenant: tenant-8142. sample curl they sent: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{"model_id":"rerank-legacy-v1","queries":["q1"],"documents":[["d1","d2"]]}'`

leo: seeing a 404 from router logs for that model id, but backend has a legacy alias `rerank-legacy-v1` which should map to `rerank-v2-stable` — looks like alias record expired on 2025-11-01 (whoops). ops-bot: created incident INC-2241 and flagged alias TTL mismatch.

jun: also noticed when model id is wrong we sometimes return an empty score array instead of explicit error if input shapes mismatch. that's probably why they saw zeros earlier. I can repro locally by passing an alias that resolves to a retired variant.

sam: steps to repro (jun pls verify): 1) call /v1/rerank with model_id=rerank-legacy-v1 2) include 1 query and 2 docs 3) observe 404 then intermittent `scores: [0,0]` when fallback path tries a retired ranker.

jun: verified. attaching quick log snippet: ```[2026-02-12T14:02:03Z] router: req tenant=tenant-8142 model=rerank-legacy-v1 -> alias lookup miss
[2026-02-12T14:02:03Z] router: fallback to model=rerank-v1-deprecated (retired) -> backend 404
[2026-02-12T14:02:03Z] reranker: input_shape mismatch, returning zeroed scores for safety```

katie: customer wants immediate mitigation — they hit this in production, traffic ~120 rps. can we put back a redirect or at least return a clearer error to callers?

leo: temporary fix: re-created alias mapping for tenant-8142 pointing rerank-legacy-v1 -> rerank-v2-stable. should propagate in ~30s. also pushed small router change to return 400 + helpful message when alias resolves to retired model.

ops-bot: Alias recreate event logged: alias=rerank-legacy-v1 tenant=tenant-8142 by leo at 2026-02-12T14:05:12Z.

sam: asked customer to retry and clear client cache (some SDKs cache model ids). katie: can you confirm with them?

katie: pinged customer, they retried and report successful 200s with non-zero scores. they also saw a deprecation warning header: `X-Model-Deprecation: rerank-legacy-v1 -> rerank-v2-stable (expires 2026-03-15)`

jun: follow-ups: 1) add telemetry to surface alias-ttl-expiry in console, 2) add an explicit 404->400 mapping when alias points to retired model, 3) notify customers proactively about expiring aliases. created tasks in backlog.

leo: note for docs/devex: include sample error and recommended client behavior (clear cache, switch to new alias).

katie: thanks all. closing the loop with customer and scheduling migration assist call for next week. :white_check_mark:
